jd:
Senior AI Engineer, Agents

You will build AI agents that take real actions for engineers.

Responsibilities
- Build agentic workflows with tool use, MCP servers and multi-step planning.
- Design guardrails, human review and deterministic validation around agent actions.
- Automate engineering workflows such as testing, debugging, incident reproduction and pull-request creation with agents.
- Measure agent quality with evaluations and production telemetry.
- Ship agent-driven readiness and operational checks across many services.

Required
- Experience building LLM applications and AI agents in production.
- Experience with Python or TypeScript.
- Experience with LangGraph, LangChain or similar agent frameworks.

Preferred
- Experience with CrewAI or AutoGen.
- Experience fine-tuning models with reinforcement learning.
expected_requirements: guardrails, human review and deterministic validation
